data.name: Aetherfall
data.detailed_description:
Aetherfall is a third-person elemental post-apocalypse RPG extraction shooter set in a world where elemental energy has replaced technology.

After a meteor strike known as the Aetherfall, aether flooded the planet, disrupting electricity, weapons, and infrastructure. Cities collapsed into unstable elemental hotspots, now dominated by mutated creatures that have adapted—and evolved.

Human survivors live on the outskirts, forming small communities in the wilderness. To survive, they venture into the ruins, relying on elemental martial arts instead of guns, and aether instead of machines.

Four Core Elements. Nine Total Elements

Fire, Earth, Air, and Water form the foundation of all combat. These elements don’t exist in isolation—when they collide, they combine into new elemental forms, creating a total of nine distinct elements with unique effects and interactions.

Every fight is shaped by how elements meet, merge, and transform.

Martial Arts & Elemental Combat

Combat is fast, physical, and expressive. Channel aether through martial techniques to unleash elemental projectiles, powerful melee strikes, movement abilities, and area attacks. Positioning, timing, and element choice are just as important as raw skill.

High-Risk Extraction Gameplay

Ruined cities are dense, unpredictable, and lethal. Each run forces a decision:

  • Push deeper for greater power

  • Extract early and secure your gains

  • Or lose everything to creatures, players, or the environment

RPG Progression Through Aether

Aether fuels growth. Enhance abilities, unlock new techniques, and specialize in the elements and combinations that fit your playstyle.

Elemental Fields System

Shape the battlefield with elemental fields born from your attacks. Interact with them in real-time to unleash combos, dashes, and massive explosions.

Elemental Enemies

The creatures of the old world have been warped by the Aetherfall—ordinary animals twisted into fierce elemental predators. Each elemental mutation has unique strengths, requiring strategic adaptation and cunning to defeat.

Survive encounters with these mutated enemies , mastering elemental strategies to overcome their deadly abilities.

A Living, Hostile World

Mutated creatures control territory and react to threats. Cities are not static arenas—they are volatile environments where fights can escalate fast and survival is never guaranteed.

Dynamic PvPvE Combat

In Aetherfall, danger comes from all sides: enemy players, mutated beasts, and the world itself. Stalk weakened rivals after a tough boss fight, clash head-on in fair duels, or play it safe on the outskirts. The choice is yours.

With match lengths ranging from quick 15-minute runs to hour-long marathons, every expedition is shaped by your strategy, risk appetite, and survival instincts.

Who AetherFall is For

  • Players who enjoy high-tension extraction gameplay

  • Fans of deep combat systems and elemental synergy

  • Those who want fantasy power in a modern, grounded world

  • Players who value risk, mastery, and meaningful progression

If this sounds interesting and you want to stay up to date on news, please add it to your wishlist!

data.short_description: Aetherfall is an elemental post-apocalypse extraction RPG set on a modern Earth where technology has failed and elemental power rules. Master fire, earth, air, and water, combine them into new elements, and risk everything as you fight to survive and grow stronger.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: 64-bit Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-4430 / AMD FX-6300
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 960 2GB / AMD Radeon R7 370 2GB
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 50 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: 64-bit Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-6600K / AMD Ryzen 5 1600
  • Memory: 16 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 3GB / AMD Radeon RX 580 4GB
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 60 GB available space
